seams_opened.title: Provider streaming tool_calls fidelity risk: gemini / bedrock / azure tool-call delta shape
seams_opened.impact: The loop accumulates `delta.tool_calls` by `.index` with chunked `.function.arguments` — the OpenAI/Azure convention. Gemini and Bedrock route through litellm's translation layer; a provider whose litellm stream omits a stable per-chunk index, or emits whole-arguments-in-one-chunk, may need a tolerance tweak. The OpenAI/Azure path is the safest live bet; gemini/bedrock are the ones to target the owner's live gate at.
seams_opened.evidence: Mock asserts only the OpenAI-shaped delta (index + chunked arguments string); litellm normalizes other providers but the exact streamed tool_call shape per provider was not exercised offline.
